description: US tax dispute deadlines: Tax Court petition 90 days after a notice of deficiency (150 if addressed outside the US, Pub 556), Collection Due Process hearing request 30 days (Form 12153), and refund claims within 3 years of filing or 2 years of payment, whichever is later (Topic 308). United States federal, tax year 2026, as of 2026-11-21 (IRS publications, Rev. Proc. 2025-32, eCFR). General information and estimates only; no individual advice, return preparation or IRS representation (31 CFR Part 10).
